newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 11.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX substantial shareholding notices - Feb 11.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Hypercom Inc increased its relevant interest in Techway Limited on 08/02/1997, from 855,939 ordinary shares (7.58%) to 1,437,148 ordinary shares (11.41%).

As at 07/02/1997, Carlton and United Breweries Ltd has become entitled to 305,672 ordinary shares in Ballarat Brewing Company Limited (The) pursuant to the takeover offer. Carlton and United Breweries Ltd has a total entitlement of 24,500,000 ordinary shares in Ballarat Brewing Company Limited (The) (89.29%).
- - - - Dr John Orde Poynton increased its relevant interest in Cambooya Investments Limited on 24/01/1997, from 2,774,557 ordinary shares (7.38%) to 3,350,391 ordinary shares (8.91%).
Hypercom Inc became a substantial shareholder in Techway Limited on 06/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 855,339 ordinary shares (7.58%).
